name: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd
title: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd - 544209 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 volumes up 20% YoY to 1.17 lakh t and FY26 at 4.58 lakh t (+33%), but gas cuts to 35% in March and a 50%+ blended gas escalation weigh on Q1 FY27 EBITDA/t; capex capped at INR 150-200 crore.

utilisation.quote: Overall, we were at 67% capacity utilization.

capex.quote: we deferred our backward integration project

triggers.label: Capex capped at INR 150-200 cr/yr
triggers.quote: our CAPEX investment side should be capped at INR 200 crores or something like that.

triggers.label: Gas escalation ~50% blended in Q1
triggers.quote: Blended I would say would be at least about 50%.

triggers.label: Non-auto demand weak; volumes cut 35%
triggers.quote: Other than what I would say the automotive segment, all other segments that we see, we still see a lack of demand.

triggers.label: Payables up via inverse discounting
triggers.quote: we have also included a lot of discounting limits from this year, which is where you are seeing the payable going high.

guidance.quote: once conditions stabilize , we still expect us to return on our targeted 20% growth trajectory
maybe INR 150 crores – INR 200 crores, something like that, to generate enough capacities to grow at 20%.
From 6.8 lakh, it should be at least 8 lakhs.
we remain on track for achieving our total target of INR 600 crores by 2027

prior_guidance_check.quote: Our estimate for 30% was only last year.
we were able to generate a cash flow of INR 333 crores exceeding our initial target of INR 250 crores

red_flags.label: Gas-driven volume cut to 35% in March
red_flags.quote: Our production took a cut to 35%, which also had a short-term impact on our production schedule.

red_flags.label: Payables stretched via inverse discounting
red_flags.quote: we have also included a lot of discounting limits from this year, which is where you are seeing the payable going high.

evasions.quote: we would not be able to give you separate EBITDA levels for all streams.
Right now, it is very difficult. Every day is a new day.
